# Pre-market brief, Tue Oct 20, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:20 AM ET)

**Tone: Monday's AI bounce is fading; oil climbs again, so tech is soft and defensives and industrials-with-beats hold up. Fed in blackout.**

1. **Futures/AI:** Nasdaq-100 −0.4% to −0.5%, S&P flat to −0.15%, Dow +0.2% (7:07 to ~7:50 AM). KOSPI −3.7%, SK Hynix −4.2%, Korean AI data-center IPO Elice −32% on debut; iShares semis ETF −1.1% pre, NVDA −0.6%, AMD −2%, INTC −1.7%. Hyperscaler CDS at record highs (META ~108 bp, NVDA ~101 bp). ([Barron's](https://www.barrons.com/livecoverage/stock-market-news-today-102026), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-rtx-rises-ge-slips-following-quarterly-results-4959693), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/why-ai-chip-stocks-nvidia-broadcom-amd-and-intel-are-falling-in-premarket-today-october-20), [FT](https://www.ft.com/content/6dd31584-064c-4015-bf5d-e5747799ccd5))
2. **Oil/rates/BTC:** Brent ~$110–111, WTI ~$100.7 (+2%) on Houthi strikes on Saudi energy and stalled US-Iran talks. 10y ~5.12%, BTC ~$81.4k (−0.5%), gold ~$4,120. ([investingLive](https://investinglive.com/news/investinglive-european-news-wrap-rising-oil-prices-keep-weighing-on-risk-sentiment/), [Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---korea-slides-as-brent-holds-near-110---20-october-2026-20102026), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/20/bitcoin-drops-to-usd81-400-as-asian-chip-stocks-tumble-options-traders-seek-downside-protection))
3. **Earnings movers:** RTX +1–2% (adj EPS $2.26 vs $1.78; FY EPS guide raised to $7.65–7.75, revenue $97.0–97.5B). HAL +3.4% (beat: $0.60, revenue $5.7B). GM −5% to −7% (beat, but narrowed EBIT guide; new $20B buyback). GE −2% (raised guide, FCF light). GPC −8% (narrowed EPS guide). STLD −5%. AAPL −1% (Loop to Hold). ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-rtx-gm-noc-stld.html), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-rtx-rises-ge-slips-following-quarterly-results-4959693), [Investing GM](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/gm-stock-falls-despite-thirdquarter-earnings-beat-4959529))
4. **Data/Fed:** ADP weekly 8:15, housing starts 8:30 (est 1.30M). NAHB fell to 29, lowest since 2012. Fed blackout until the Oct 28 decision; markets price a hold, then three hikes by July. ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---korea-slides-as-brent-holds-near-110---20-october-2026-20102026))
5. **After the close:** NFLX, SpaceX, ISRG, UAL, COF. Wed: META, TSLA, IBM, LRCX, TXN. ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-gb/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---korea-slides-as-brent-holds-near-110---20-october-2026-20102026), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/20/bitcoin-drops-to-usd81-400-as-asian-chip-stocks-tumble-options-traders-seek-downside-protection))

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **RTX**: big beat plus raised EPS and revenue guide; defense/aero is outside the AI-debt trade. Conf: med. Risk: the gap fades if the tape rotates back into tech; the guide includes a $0.25/share tariff-refund boost.
- **HAL**: beat on EPS and revenue with oil >$100. Conf: low. Risk: oil premium reverses fast on de-escalation headlines (lesson 10/09).

**Holds, no re-add:** AMZN, DDOG, BLK, XLP, CLF. **New avoids:** GM, GPC (guide disappointments). **Avoids kept:** semis/memory, AI optics, AI-debt infra, airlines (Brent ~$111), BAC.
